summary: Stripe 2026-03-25.dahlia renames Checkout Session ui_mode values
details:
From API version 2026-03-25.dahlia, Checkout Session ui_mode values hosted, embedded and custom are replaced by hosted_page, embedded_page and elements (and form is added). Creating a session with an old value fails, and code that compares the returned ui_mode to the old strings stops matching once the account or SDK is upgraded.

When moving to 2026-03-25.dahlia or later, send ui_mode hosted_page instead of hosted, embedded_page instead of embedded and elements instead of custom, and update every comparison of session.ui_mode (including checkout.session webhook handlers) to the new values; handle the new form value too.
